Simulate Goto: Loop until 'stop'

Problem Statement:
Simulate a "goto" statement using loops and conditional statements. Write a program that continuously asks the user for input and stops only when the user inputs a specific keyword. 
Input Description:
Multiple strings, one per line. 
Output Description:
Each string entered by the user until the keyword "stop" is encountered. 
Sample Input:
hello
world
stop 
Sample Output:
hello
world
